courses.title: MS Word
courses.description: Learn MS Word by creating real documents and completing practical projects.

lessons.title: Preparing Application Form
lessons.short: Create the Project 1 admission application form.
concepts: Text formatting: bold, underline and alignment
steps: Open Microsoft Word and create a blank document.
Set the page size and margins as required.
Add the small picture/logo at the top-left and resize it.
Create the Form No. area using a table.
Type the heading “Application for Admission”, center it and apply underline.
Create the Name, Father’s/Husband Name, Occupation, Date of Birth and Address fields using text and dotted lines.
Create the phone-number boxes using a table.
Add the Current Occupational Status options.
Insert the horizontal/dashed separator and create the Acknowledgement Receipt and Hall Ticket section.
Add signatures and date at the bottom. Compare your result with the project image.
lessons.practiceIntro: Recreate Project 1 yourself in MS Word. Do not copy-paste the finished picture.

practice.question: Create the complete Application for Admission form shown above.
practice.answer: Your final page should visually match the Project 1 image: heading, form fields, phone boxes, occupational-status options, acknowledgement section and signatures.

practice.question: Create the phone-number boxes using a table instead of typing vertical lines.
practice.answer: Insert a one-row table with the required number of cells, adjust cell width/height, and keep the borders visible.

lessons.title: Prepare an Admission Notification
lessons.short: Create the Project 2 admission notification using Word shapes, text and formatting.
steps: Create a new Word document.
Add the page border and light background area.
Type the university heading and format it prominently.
Create the “Admissions open” heading using large decorative text.
Add the eligibility criteria and how-to-apply sections.
Create colored boxes/shapes for contact details and the special offer.
Place the last-date text prominently.
Add footer date and page number.

practice.question: Recreate Project 2 from the reference image using Word shapes and formatted text.
practice.answer: Use separate text boxes/shapes for the main title, eligibility, last date, contact box and offer box.

lessons.title: Prepare a Sale Advertisement
lessons.short: Create a colourful sale advertisement using Word shapes and text effects.
steps: Insert a suitable page background.
Create the “END OF SEASON SALE” heading with decorative text.
Insert a starburst shape for the main discount offer.
Add offer text inside shapes.
Create the different promotional shapes at the bottom.
Apply colors, outlines and text effects.
Arrange all objects to match the reference image.

practice.question: Create the complete Project 3 sale advertisement.
practice.answer: Your design should contain the main sale heading, discount starburst, gift voucher offer and the three lower promotional shapes.

lessons.title: Prepare a Cover Page of a Book
lessons.short: Design a book cover using WordArt, shapes, picture and text boxes.
steps: Create the page border.
Add the book title at the top.
Insert the large arrow shapes and format their fill.
Add the mathematics formula in a cloud shape.
Insert the illustration.
Create the green information box.
Add the bottom publisher scroll/banner.
Align all elements and compare with the reference.

practice.question: Recreate Project 4 as a book cover in MS Word.
practice.answer: Use Word shapes and text boxes to reproduce the title, arrows, formula cloud, information box, illustration and publisher banner.

lessons.title: Prepare a Sales Advertisement
lessons.short: Create the Project 5 clothing sales advertisement.
steps: Create the main title and subtitle.
Insert the fashion picture/background.
Create the circular discount shape.
Add the sale and offer text.
Create the women’s and men’s apparel sections.
Create the store-location table.
Add the discount list at the bottom-right.
Arrange and align all objects to match the reference.

practice.question: Create the complete Bella Vista Clothing advertisement.
practice.answer: Reproduce the major sections: title, SALE, discount circle, apparel categories, store table and discount list.

lessons.title: Prepare a Marketing Planning Cycle
lessons.short: Create the Project 6 marketing planning cycle diagram.
steps: Create the title banner.
Draw the circular planning-cycle diagram using shapes and arrows.
Add Analysis, Objectives, Strategy, Resources, Implementation and Evaluation.
Add the explanatory text on the right and below.
Create the blue guidance-sheet banner.
Align and group related objects.

practice.question: Recreate the complete Marketing Planning Cycle shown in Project 6.
practice.answer: Your page should include the cycle diagram, analysis/objectives/strategy/resources/implementation/evaluation sections and the guidance-sheet banner.

courses.title: MS Excel
courses.description: Learn Excel through formulas, tables and practical office tasks.

lessons.title: Basic Calculation
lessons.short: Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
steps: Enter sample values in cells.
Click the result cell.
Type = followed by the cell references and operator.
Press Enter and verify the result.

practice.question: If B2 contains 100 and C2 contains 25, calculate the total using a formula.
If B2 contains 100 and C2 contains 25, calculate 25% of B2 using a formula.

lessons.title: SUM Function
lessons.short: Calculate totals from a range of numbers.
steps: Enter numbers in B2:B6.
Select the result cell.
Type =SUM(B2:B6).
Press Enter.
